items.name: Default
items.summary: Basic decimal formatting with localized grouping separators. Use for inline counts and metrics.

items.name: Currency
items.template: 1234.56 1234.56 1234
items.summary: Currency formatting for monetary values with locale-aware symbols and separators. Use for prices, budgets, and financial totals.

items.name: Percent
items.summary: Percent formatting for ratios and completion values. Source values should already represent a fraction (such as 0.85 for 85 percent).

items.name: Unit
items.template: 1234.56 2048 22
items.summary: Unit formatting for measurements and quantities. Use for distances, storage sizes, or other numeric labels that need a localized unit suffix.

items.name: Notation
items.summary: Notation presets for scientific, engineering, and compact display. Use compact notation in dashboards or cards where space matters.

items.name: SignDisplay
items.summary: Sign display options for controlling positive and negative indicators. Use 'always' for delta values or 'exceptZero' for change indicators.

items.name: FractionDigits
items.summary: Fraction digit control for tuning decimal precision. Use to enforce fixed decimal places in financial or scientific contexts.

items.name: Locale
items.template: 1234.56 1234 1234567.89
items.summary: Explicit locale settings for internationalized number output. Use when the target audience locale differs from the document language or browser default.

items.name: NumberAttribute
items.summary: Number attribute input for values supplied by JavaScript or bound data. By default, the component formats text content, which also serves as the SSR fallback, and `number` wins when both are present.
